task_definition.task_description: Please check the current UTC time, confirm whether the crypto market is open, get the latest BTC price in USD, and then convert that USD value to EUR. After that, send me an in-app medium-priority alert saying “BTC market check completed. Review the latest USD price and converted value.”, and then create a backup snapshot of the finance-monitor workspace named 2026-02-22.

user_input.query: Please check the current UTC time, confirm whether the crypto market is open, and get the latest price for BTC in USD. Then convert that USD value to EUR. After that, send an app alert to user_123 with medium priority using the exact message: “BTC market check completed. Review the latest USD price and converted value.” Finally, create a backup snapshot of the finance-monitor workspace at /workspace/finance-monitor named 2026-02-22.
